_readme: How Pegasus starts each emulator. Only entries with verified=true are written as active 'launch:' lines; the rest are written commented out with a note asking the user to test and report. Every entry needs 'source' and 'verified_date' (for unverified entries: the date the source was last checked). Placeholders: {file.uri} / {file.path} are filled in by Pegasus.

profiles.verified_on: AYN Odin 2 Portal, Android 13, ARMSX2 2.7.x from the Play Store
profiles.source: Real device test by the project owner; see also https://github.com/inssekt/CocoonFE/pull/449
profiles.notes: The Play Store build keeps the package id 'come.nanodata.armsx2' (note: 'come', not 'com') but its classes moved to 'com.armsx2.*', so the fully qualified activity is required.

profiles.source: Package id of the GitHub release build. This exact line FAILED with ActivityNotFoundException on a Play Store install, so it only applies to the GitHub build.
profiles.notes: Only for the GitHub build of ARMSX2. If you installed ARMSX2 from the Play Store, use the Play Store profile instead.

profiles.launch:
am start
  -n com.retroarch/.browser.retroactivity.RetroActivityFuture
  -e ROM "{file.path}"
  -e LIBRETRO /data/data/com.retroarch/cores/mupen64plus_next_gles3_libretro_android.so
  -e CONFIGFILE /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.retroarch/files/retroarch.cfg
  -e IME com.android.inputmethod.latin/.LatinIME
  -e DATADIR /data/data/com.retroarch
  -e SDCARD /storage/emulated/0
  -e EXTERNAL /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.retroarch/files
profiles.source: Project owner's working metadata.pegasus.txt, games launched from Pegasus on a real device
profiles.notes: Install the 'Nintendo - Nintendo 64 (Mupen64Plus-Next)' core first (RetroArch → Online Updater → Core Downloader). This is for RetroArch from the Play Store; the 64-bit build from retroarch.com uses 'com.retroarch.aarch64'.

profiles.launch:
am start --user 0
  -n com.retroarch.aarch64/com.retroarch.browser.retroactivity.RetroActivityFuture
  -e ROM {file.path}
  -e LIBRETRO /data/data/com.retroarch.aarch64/cores/snes9x_libretro_android.so
  -e CONFIGFILE /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.retroarch.aarch64/files/retroarch.cfg
  -e QUITFOCUS
  --activity-clear-top
  --activity-clear-task
  --activity-no-history
profiles.source: Pegasus docs, Platform Notes: Android (RetroArch64 example) https://pegasus-frontend.org/docs/user-guide/platform-android/
profiles.notes: Install the Snes9x core first (RetroArch → Online Updater → Core Downloader). Only for the 64-bit build from retroarch.com; for the Play Store RetroArch use the 'RetroArch (Play Store)' profile.

profiles.source: Project owner's working metadata.pegasus.txt, games launched from Pegasus on a real device; package and activity from the melonDS Android README https://github.com/rafaelvcaetano/melonDS-android
profiles.notes: melonDS needs the ROM folder added in its own settings first. '--grant-read-uri-permission' lets melonDS open the game Pegasus hands it.
